AI.research_question: 如何通过描述性分析和规范性优化相结合的方法，有效减少制药包装线的产品换线时间，提高运营效率？
AI.motivation: 制药制造系统中换线时间导致的效率低下问题，现有手动调度方法效率不高，需要数据驱动的优化方法来提升运营绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于旅行商问题(TSP)的排序模型，结合相似性产品聚类理论，构建描述性分析与规范性优化的集成框架。
AI.method: 两阶段优化方法：第一阶段通过相似性产品聚类进行描述性分析；第二阶段采用TSP模型进行规范性优化，使用Gurobi精确求解和蚁群算法元启发式方法。
AI.findings: 随着产品复杂度增加，蚁群算法性能优于或等同于精确求解器；产品聚类可进一步减少换线时间；在制药公司四条生产线上的应用显示换线时间最多减少19.3%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合描述性分析和规范性优化的两阶段框架，扩展了TSP模型在制药制造中的应用，验证了聚类在运营决策中的价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制药公司提供了可降低19.3%换线时间的实用工具，可推广到其他医疗和生命科学制造环境，支持更标准化和可预测的排序策略。

title: How Effective was the Japan-US Coordinated Rate Check?
affiliations: Kobe City University of Foreign Studies and Kobe City University of Foreign Studies

detail.title: How Effective was the Japan-US Coordinated Rate Check?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the JSPS KAKENHI Grant Numbers 25K05170.

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the effectiveness of the unprecedented Japan-US coordinated rate check (CRC) conducted on January 23, 2026, as a preparatory action toward implementing foreign exchange (FX) intervention. We first estimate the lasting effect of the CRC using our methodology based on synthetic control methods. We find that the effect of the CRC significantly lasted for 7 business days after the end of the CRC. We then compare the CRC with the four FX intervention events in 2022-24. We find that the power of the lasting effect of the CRC was roughly equivalent to that of the large-scale yen-buying intervention event of April 29 and May 1, 2024. Therefore, despite not actually implementing FX intervention, this coordinated action by the Japanese and US monetary authorities proved effective in correcting the yen’s depreciation against the dollar.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了2026年1月23日美日协调汇率检查(CRC)作为外汇干预准备行动的有效性。研究发现CRC效果持续7个交易日，其持久效应与2024年4-5月大规模日元买入干预相当，证明即使未实际干预，协调行动也能有效纠正日元贬值。
AI.research_question: 美日协调汇率检查(CRC)作为外汇干预准备行动的有效性如何？其效果持续多久？与2022-24年实际外汇干预事件相比效果如何？
AI.motivation: 评估央行协调行动作为外汇干预准备工具的有效性，特别是在未实际实施干预的情况下，这种协调行动能否有效影响汇率走势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外汇干预理论、央行协调行动有效性、信号传递理论、合成控制方法在政策评估中的应用
AI.method: 采用合成控制方法估计CRC的持续效应，并将CRC与2022-24年四次实际外汇干预事件进行比较分析
AI.findings: 1) CRC效果显著持续7个交易日；2) CRC的持久效应与2024年4月29日和5月1日大规模日元买入干预事件相当；3) 即使未实际实施外汇干预，美日货币当局的协调行动也能有效纠正日元兑美元贬值
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了央行协调行动有效性的理论框架，证明准备性协调行动与实际干预具有相似的政策效果，为信号传递理论提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行提供新的政策工具选择，表明协调汇率检查可作为实际干预的有效替代或准备，降低干预成本的同时保持政策效果

title: Fire or hire as a response to Covid-19? Human and social capital as antecedents of workforce reductions in family firms
affiliations: University of South-Eastern Norway, Bocconi University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Fire or hire as a response to Covid-19? Human and social capital as antecedents of workforce reductions in family firms
detail.abstract: From a resources-based view, this study sheds light on how two different types of family resources, their human and social capital, influenced workforce reductions in family firms during the Covid-19 pandemic. Furthermore, we provide a nuanced understanding of these relationships by exploring the heterogeneity of family firms through the role played by the founding generation. Theoretical hypotheses are tested using global survey data comprising of a final sample of 1,805 observations from 75 different countries. The main findings suggest that while family human capital has a negative impact on the size of the workforce during a crisis, family social capital does not lead to workforce reductions. Moreover, the negative effect that family human capital has on workforce size strengthens when the founding generation of the family is involved. These findings have important implications for understanding the impact of family resources from a resource-based view, providing valuable insights into how resources can be transformed into actions that determine responses to crisis, while underscoring that different generational dynamics impact these responses.

AI.tldr: 基于资源基础观，本研究探讨了家族企业中的人力资本和社会资本这两种不同类型的家族资源如何影响新冠疫情期间的裁员规模，并分析了创始代参与对上述关系的调节作用。
AI.research_question: 家族企业的人力资本和社会资本如何影响其在危机期间（新冠疫情）的裁员决策？创始代的参与如何调节这些关系？
AI.motivation: 理解家族企业在危机期间如何利用其独特的家族资源（人力资本和社会资本）做出应对决策，特别是裁员决策，并探讨不同代际动态如何影响资源转化为行动的过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（Resource-Based View），重点关注家族企业特有的两种资源：家族人力资本（家族成员的知识、技能、经验）和家族社会资本（家族网络、关系、信任）。
AI.method: 使用全球调查数据，最终样本包含来自75个不同国家的1,805个观测值，通过实证分析检验理论假设。
AI.findings: 1. 家族人力资本对危机期间的裁员规模有负向影响（即人力资本越多，裁员越少）；2. 家族社会资本对裁员决策没有显著影响；3. 创始代的参与会强化家族人力资本对裁员的负向影响（即创始代参与时，人力资本越多越倾向于不裁员）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 从资源基础观角度深化了对家族企业危机应对机制的理解；2. 揭示了不同类型家族资源（人力资本vs社会资本）在危机中的不同作用；3. 强调了代际动态在资源转化为危机应对行动中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为家族企业管理者提供了关于如何利用家族资源应对危机的指导；2. 强调了创始代参与在危机决策中的重要性；3. 帮助政策制定者理解家族企业在危机中的行为模式。

title: Comparative Analysis of Maintenance Optimization Approaches in African Offshore Platforms

detail.title: Comparative Analysis of Maintenance Optimization Approaches in African Offshore Platforms
detail.abstract: Offshore oil and gas platforms operating in Africa face persistent challenges related to high operational expenditure, aging infrastructure, safety risks, and unplanned downtime, all of which are closely linked to maintenance effectiveness. This study conducts a comparative analysis of maintenance optimization approaches applied within African offshore platforms, with particular focus on preventive, reliability-centered, predictive, and digitally enabled maintenance models. Drawing on peer-reviewed literature and documented case insights from African and comparable offshore environments, the study evaluates these approaches using cost efficiency, downtime reduction, safety performance, and contextual feasibility as comparative criteria. The findings indicate that while advanced predictive and AI-driven maintenance systems demonstrate strong potential for cost and downtime reduction, their effectiveness is significantly constrained by infrastructural, data, and skill limitations prevalent in many African offshore contexts. Hybrid maintenance strategies that integrate traditional reliability-centered practices with selective digital tools emerge as the most viable and resilient solution. The study concludes that maintenance optimization in African offshore platforms must prioritize contextual adaptability rather than direct replication of global best practices, and it recommends phased, capacity-aware implementation pathways for sustainable performance improvement (Uke; Joseph; Shamim; Animashaun et al.).

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了非洲海上油气平台的维护优化方法，发现虽然预测性和AI驱动的维护系统有潜力，但在非洲环境下受到基础设施、数据和技能限制。混合维护策略（结合传统可靠性中心维护与选择性数字工具）是最可行的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 在非洲海上油气平台环境中，不同维护优化方法（预防性、可靠性中心、预测性、数字化维护）在成本效率、停机时间减少、安全性能和上下文可行性方面的比较效果如何？
AI.motivation: 非洲海上油气平台面临高运营成本、基础设施老化、安全风险和计划外停机等持续挑战，这些问题都与维护有效性密切相关，需要找到适合当地环境的优化解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于维护管理理论，包括预防性维护、可靠性中心维护(RCM)、预测性维护和数字化维护模型，结合非洲特定环境下的适应性理论。
AI.method: 比较分析方法，基于同行评审文献和非洲及类似海上环境的案例研究，使用成本效率、停机时间减少、安全性能和上下文可行性作为比较标准。
AI.findings: 先进的预测性和AI驱动维护系统在成本和停机时间减少方面有潜力，但在非洲环境下受基础设施、数据和技能限制。混合维护策略（传统可靠性中心实践与选择性数字工具结合）是最可行和有韧性的解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了维护优化在发展中地区需要上下文适应性的理论框架，挑战了直接复制全球最佳实践的假设，强调了混合策略的理论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲海上平台提供了分阶段、能力感知的实施路径建议，推荐混合维护策略作为可持续性能改进的实用方案，强调上下文适应性而非直接技术移植。

title: From Making to Directing: How AI Creativity Studios Reorganize Creative Labor in Cultural Industries

detail.title: From Making to Directing: How AI Creativity Studios Reorganize Creative Labor in Cultural Industries
detail.abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative artificial intelligence in cultural and creative industries has intensified debates about whether machines can be considered creative actors. This paper shifts the focus from questions of machine creativity to the organizational transformation of creative work. We argue that contemporary AI creativity studios-software platforms that structure cinematic and visual production through stepwise workflows-reorganize creative labor by transforming human creators from makers into directors of machine-mediated production pipelines. Drawing on an artifact-centered qualitative approach, the study combines walkthrough analysis and decision-rights mapping to examine how creative decisions are distributed across humans, platform workflows, and generative models. Using Higgsfield.ai as a primary empirical exemplar, alongside comparable AI video-generation platforms, we analyze how creative processes are proceduralized, parameterized, and governed through interface design and embedded defaults. Our analysis shows that AI creativity studios do not replace human creativity; rather, they redistribute authorship, agency, and control across socio-technical systems, reshaping creative labor identities and professional boundaries. By conceptualizing AI as an organizational infrastructure for creative production, the paper contributes to research on creative industries, human-AI work arrangements, and innovation management. We conclude by outlining implications for authorship attribution, creative labor governance, and future empirical research on AI-mediated cultural production.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究生成式AI如何重组创意劳动，将人类创作者从制作者转变为机器中介生产流程的导演，通过平台工作流程重新分配创意决策权。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI创意工作室如何重组创意劳动，重新分配人类、平台工作流程和生成模型之间的创意决策权？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在文化和创意产业中的快速扩散引发了关于机器能否被视为创意参与者的争论，但论文将焦点从机器创造力问题转向创意工作的组织转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创意产业研究、人机协作工作安排、创新管理理论，将AI概念化为创意生产的组织基础设施。
AI.method: 基于人工制品的定性方法，结合walkthrough分析和决策权映射，以Higgsfield.ai为主要实证案例，辅以可比的AI视频生成平台。
AI.findings: AI创意工作室并未取代人类创造力，而是通过界面设计和嵌入式默认设置，将创意过程程序化、参数化和治理化，重新分配作者身份、能动性和控制权，重塑创意劳动身份和专业边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI概念化为创意生产的组织基础设施，为创意产业、人机工作安排和创新管理研究做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为作者身份归属、创意劳动治理和AI中介文化生产的未来实证研究提供启示。

title: Optimizing Maintenance Strategies to Extend Asset Life in Offshore Operations

detail.title: Optimizing Maintenance Strategies to Extend Asset Life in Offshore Operations
detail.abstract: Offshore operations are characterized by harsh environmental conditions, complex mechanical systems, and high operational costs, all of which accelerate asset degradation and shorten equipment lifespan. As offshore infrastructure ages, operators face increasing pressure to maintain reliability, safety, and cost efficiency while extending asset life. This study synthesizes and evaluates optimization-based maintenance strategies applied across offshore oil, gas, wind, and marine operations. Drawing on recent scholarly and industry literature, the study examines preventive, predictive, reliability-centered, and digital twin-enabled maintenance approaches and assesses their effectiveness in extending asset life and improving operational performance. The findings indicate that proactive, data-driven, and probabilistic maintenance strategies significantly outperform traditional time-based approaches in reducing failure rates, minimizing downtime, and optimizing lifecycle costs. However, the study also reveals persistent implementation challenges related to data availability, organizational readiness, and environmental variability. The paper concludes that integrated maintenance optimization frameworks, supported by automation and digital technologies, are essential for sustainable offshore asset management. Future research directions include real-time empirical validation and cross-sector implementation studies to bridge the gap between theoretical optimization models and operational practice (Zhang et al.; Uke; Hendradewa and Yin; Budimir et al.).

AI.tldr: 该研究综合评估了海上油气、风电和海洋作业中基于优化的维护策略，发现主动、数据驱动和概率性维护策略在减少故障率、最小化停机时间和优化生命周期成本方面显著优于传统时间基准方法。
AI.research_question: 基于优化的维护策略在海上作业中如何有效延长资产寿命并提高运营性能？
AI.motivation: 海上作业面临恶劣环境条件、复杂机械系统和高运营成本，加速资产退化并缩短设备寿命。随着海上基础设施老化，运营商需要在保持可靠性、安全性和成本效益的同时延长资产寿命。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预防性维护、预测性维护、可靠性中心维护、数字孪生支持的维护方法等优化框架。
AI.method: 综合评估方法，基于近期学术和行业文献，分析海上油气、风电和海洋作业中的维护策略。
AI.findings: 主动、数据驱动和概率性维护策略在减少故障率、最小化停机时间和优化生命周期成本方面显著优于传统时间基准方法。但实施中面临数据可用性、组织准备度和环境变异性等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为海上资产维护提供了综合优化框架的理论基础，整合了预防性、预测性、可靠性中心和数字孪生等多种维护方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海上作业运营商提供了实用的维护策略选择指南，强调自动化支持、数字技术集成的维护优化框架对可持续资产管理的必要性。

title: Integrating Human Factors into Maintenance Strategy Models for Offshore Operations

detail.title: Integrating Human Factors into Maintenance Strategy Models for Offshore Operations
detail.abstract: Offshore operations are complex, high-risk environments that rely heavily on effective maintenance strategies to ensure operational safety, reliability, and sustainability (Uke; Mustafa and Demirel; Bukowski and Werbinska-Wojciechowska). Traditional maintenance optimization models often focus on technical and asset-centered metrics while neglecting critical human factors (Bafandegan Emroozi et al.; Lezdkalne). This study synthesizes contemporary literature on maintenance strategies, human reliability, and offshore safety to explore pathways for integrating human factors into maintenance models. Key findings indicate that human error probability, cognitive workload, fatigue, and organizational culture significantly influence maintenance outcomes. Moreover, conventional models inadequately capture the dynamic interactions between humans, technology, and organizational systems (Melnyk et al.; Song et al.). Integrating human factors into maintenance strategies not only reduces risk but also improves operational efficiency and resilience. The study provides a conceptual framework for combining human reliability insights with maintenance optimization, offering practical implications for offshore operators seeking to enhance safety and performance (Cui et al.; Bukowski and Werbinska-Wojciechowska).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨如何将人为因素整合到海上作业维护策略中，指出传统维护模型忽视人为因素，而整合人为因素可降低风险、提高运营效率和韧性。
AI.research_question: 如何将人为因素整合到海上作业的维护优化模型中？
AI.motivation: 海上作业环境复杂高风险，传统维护模型过于关注技术和资产指标，忽视了人为因素对维护结果的重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 维护策略、人为可靠性、海上安全理论，以及人-技术-组织系统的动态交互理论。
AI.method: 文献综述法，综合当代关于维护策略、人为可靠性和海上安全的文献。
AI.findings: 人为错误概率、认知负荷、疲劳和组织文化显著影响维护结果；传统模型未能充分捕捉人、技术和组织系统间的动态交互。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将人为可靠性见解与维护优化相结合的概念框架，丰富了维护理论和人为因素理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海上作业运营商提供了整合人为因素的实用指导，有助于增强安全性和运营绩效。

title: Advanced Modeling Techniques for Offshore Oil Platform Reliability and Maintenance

detail.title: Advanced Modeling Techniques for Offshore Oil Platform Reliability and Maintenance
detail.abstract: Offshore oil platforms are vital for global energy supply, but their complex operations are susceptible to equipment failures, structural degradation, and unplanned downtime. This study evaluates advanced modeling techniques including artificial intelligence (AI), Bayesian networks, and digital twin approaches to enhance platform reliability and optimize maintenance strategies. Using a combination of historical operational data, predictive algorithms, and structural simulations, the research demonstrates that integrated modeling significantly reduces maintenance-related downtime and improves decision-making for critical equipment management. Findings indicate that predictive maintenance models outperform traditional preventive strategies in both accuracy and cost-efficiency, while Bayesian network reliability assessments provide robust probabilistic insights. Digital twin implementations enable proactive structural monitoring, highlighting vulnerabilities before failures occur. The study concludes that integrating AI, probabilistic reliability modeling, and digital twin simulation establishes a practical framework for offshore platform maintenance, providing both operational and economic benefits while guiding future research on adaptive predictive models and sensor integration.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了人工智能、贝叶斯网络和数字孪生等先进建模技术，以提升海上石油平台的可靠性并优化维护策略。研究发现集成建模能显著减少维护相关停机时间，提高关键设备管理的决策质量。
AI.research_question: 如何利用先进建模技术（AI、贝叶斯网络、数字孪生）来提升海上石油平台的可靠性并优化维护策略？
AI.motivation: 海上石油平台对全球能源供应至关重要，但其复杂运营容易受到设备故障、结构退化和计划外停机的影响，需要更有效的维护方法来确保可靠性和安全性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人工智能预测建模、贝叶斯网络可靠性评估和数字孪生仿真技术的理论框架，结合预测性维护理论、概率可靠性分析和结构监测理论。
AI.method: 结合历史运营数据、预测算法和结构模拟的综合研究方法，包括数据驱动的AI建模、贝叶斯网络概率分析和数字孪生仿真技术。
AI.findings: 1. 集成建模显著减少维护相关停机时间；2. 预测性维护模型在准确性和成本效益上优于传统预防性策略；3. 贝叶斯网络可靠性评估提供稳健的概率洞察；4. 数字孪生实现主动结构监测，能在故障发生前识别脆弱点。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了AI、概率可靠性建模和数字孪生仿真的集成理论框架，为海上平台维护提供了新的理论视角，推动了预测性维护和可靠性评估理论的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海上石油平台提供了实用的维护框架，带来运营和经济效益，指导未来自适应预测模型和传感器集成的研究方向，提升平台安全性和运营效率。

title: Innovation Contests and R&D Policy
affiliations: University of Melbourne - Faculty of Business and Economics and University of Melbourne - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: Innovation Contests and R&D Policy
detail.abstract: Innovation contests are widely used for the procurement of innovation. We compare the problem of a private and a public seeker organizing an innovation contest where participants are privately informed about the quality of their ideas. The innovation has to satisfy a predetermined performance threshold to be of use to the seeker. Profit-maximizing seekers underinvest in innovation contests. We investigate how efficiency can be achieved by an R&D policy defined in terms of a matching ratio, which can take, for example, the form of a subsidy or a tax credit. We show that the efficient matching ratio should be lower for more difficult challenges and challenges with a higher number of contestants.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了私人和公共寻求者在创新竞赛中的投资决策，发现利润最大化的寻求者会投资不足，并提出通过匹配比率（如补贴或税收抵免）的研发政策来实现效率，匹配比率应根据挑战难度和参赛者数量调整。
AI.research_question: 私人和公共寻求者在创新竞赛中的投资决策有何差异？如何通过研发政策（如匹配比率）实现创新竞赛的效率？
AI.motivation: 创新竞赛被广泛用于采购创新，但利润最大化的寻求者往往投资不足，导致效率损失，需要研究如何通过政策干预实现效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论（参与者对创意质量有私人信息），创新竞赛理论，以及公共政策经济学中的匹配比率概念。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，比较私人和公共寻求者的决策，分析匹配比率政策对效率的影响。
AI.findings: 利润最大化的寻求者在创新竞赛中投资不足；有效的匹配比率应随挑战难度增加而降低，随参赛者数量增加而降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了私人和公共寻求者创新竞赛的比较理论框架；2) 提出了匹配比率作为实现效率的政策工具；3) 揭示了挑战难度和参赛者数量对最优匹配比率的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者设计创新竞赛补贴政策提供理论依据；2) 指导企业根据挑战特性和竞争环境调整研发投入；3) 帮助公共部门更有效地组织创新竞赛。

title: Impressions for a Lifetime: Youth Exposure to Immigration and Anti-immigrant Sentiment in Germany
affiliations: University of Essex, Centro Studi Luca d'Agliano (LdA), Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca - Department of Economics, Management and Statistics (DEMS) and

detail.title: Impressions for a Lifetime: Youth Exposure to Immigration and Anti-immigrant Sentiment in Germany

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management and Statistics Working Paper No. 571
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management & Statistics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the impact of exposure to immigrants during formative years on attitudes toward immigration later on in life. Our research design combines granular administrative data on immigrant shares in Germany with longitudinal individual-level data on immigration sentiment. Using panel fixed-effect estimates, identification leverages both spatial variation at critical ages and time variation induced by birth cohorts. We find that individuals exposed to higher shares of immigrants in formative years exhibit more negative attitudes toward immigration in adulthood. The impact is small in magnitude but specific to critical age and robust to contemporaneous immigration exposure. Our findings suggest that early and unmediated exposure to a diverse social and ethnic environment may have long-lasting consequences for the formation of immigration preferences.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在成长关键期接触更多移民的个体，成年后对移民持更负面态度。影响虽小但持久，且不受同期移民接触影响。
AI.research_question: 成长关键期接触移民的经历如何影响成年后的移民态度？
AI.motivation: 理解移民态度的形成机制，特别是早期经历对长期偏好的影响，对移民政策和社会融合有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关键期假说、态度形成理论、社会接触理论
AI.method: 使用德国行政移民数据和纵向个体态度数据，采用面板固定效应模型，结合空间变异和出生队列时间变异进行识别。
AI.findings: 成长关键期接触更高比例移民的个体，成年后对移民持更负面态度。影响虽小但特定于关键年龄，且不受同期移民接触影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了关键期假说在移民态度形成中的应用，揭示了早期非中介接触对长期偏好的持久影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民政策制定提供依据，强调早期社会融合干预的重要性，帮助理解移民态度的代际传递。

title: Attention (And Money) Is All You Need: Why Universities Are Struggling to Keep AI Talent
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics, University of Chicago, Center for Economic Studies - US Census Bureau and Economic Innovation Group

detail.title: Attention (And Money) Is All You Need: Why Universities Are Struggling to Keep AI Talent
detail.abstract:
We construct a novel dataset linking academic publication records to U.S. Census employer–employee data to track 42,000 AI researchers over two decades. We document systematic changes in the allocation of AI talent. Industry increasingly attracts younger and foreign-born researchers, while gender representation improves more in academia. The top 1% of publishing industry scientists now earn $1.5 million more annually than comparable academics, a fivefold increase since 2001. Rising wage premia coincide with greater sorting into large incumbent firms. Researchers who move to industry publish less but patent more, consistent with a shift from open science toward proprietary innovation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过将学术出版记录与美国人口普查雇主-员工数据关联，追踪了42,000名AI研究人员20年的职业发展，发现行业对年轻和外国出生研究人员的吸引力增强，性别平等在学术界改善更明显，顶尖行业科学家的薪酬优势急剧扩大，研究人员从学术界转向产业界后发表减少但专利增加。
AI.research_question: AI人才在学术界和产业界之间的分配如何随时间变化？这种分配变化对研究人员的职业发展、薪酬和创新产出有何影响？
AI.motivation: 人工智能领域的快速发展引发了人才在学术界和产业界之间流动的重要变化，但缺乏系统性的实证证据来理解这种人才分配的变化模式及其后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人才分配理论、职业选择理论、开放科学与专有创新权衡理论、人力资本流动理论
AI.method: 构建新颖的数据集，将学术出版记录与美国人口普查雇主-员工数据关联，追踪42,000名AI研究人员20年的职业轨迹，采用计量经济学方法分析人才分配变化、薪酬差异和创新产出模式。
AI.findings: 1. 产业界越来越吸引年轻和外国出生的研究人员；2. 性别代表性在学术界改善更明显；3. 顶尖1%的产业科学家年收入比可比学术同行高150万美元，自2001年以来增长五倍；4. 高薪酬溢价与向大型现有企业的集中趋势相关；5. 转向产业界的研究人员发表减少但专利增加，表明从开放科学向专有创新转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为AI领域人才流动提供了系统的实证证据；2. 揭示了学术界与产业界在吸引不同类型人才方面的差异模式；3. 量化了薪酬差距的扩大趋势及其与企业规模的关系；4. 验证了职业转换对创新产出模式的影响，支持开放科学与专有创新的权衡理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供AI人才流动的实证基础；2. 帮助学术机构了解人才竞争态势；3. 为企业人才招聘策略提供参考；4. 为研究人员职业规划提供数据支持；5. 促进对AI创新生态系统健康发展的讨论。

title: The Evolution of Exchange: From Barter Frictions to Decentralized AI Infrastructures: Transaction Costs, Intermediation, and the Political Economy of AI-Mediated Commerce

detail.title: The Evolution of Exchange: From Barter Frictions to Decentralized AI Infrastructures: Transaction Costs, Intermediation, and the Political Economy of AI-Mediated Commerce
detail.abstract: This paper is a conceptual and historical analysis intended to clarify the structural relationship between transaction-cost reduction, intermediation, and market power. It does not present an empirical model or testable hypotheses. The framework is intended to support analysis across multiple domains in which AI-mediated coordination plays an increasing role.

AI.tldr: 本文通过概念和历史分析，阐明交易成本降低、中介化和市场权力之间的结构关系，为AI协调日益重要的多领域分析提供框架。
AI.research_question: 交易成本降低、中介化和市场权力之间的结构关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在协调中扮演越来越重要的角色，需要澄清这些核心概念之间的结构关系，以支持跨领域分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本经济学、中介理论、市场权力理论
AI.method: 概念分析和历史分析
AI.findings: 本文未提供实证结果，而是构建了一个概念框架来理解交易成本降低如何影响中介化和市场权力的动态关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了交易成本降低、中介化和市场权力之间的结构关系，为AI协调研究提供了概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业管理者和技术开发者理解AI协调对市场结构的影响提供分析工具。

title: Lifecycle Optimization of Offshore Oil Infrastructure in African Operations

detail.title: Lifecycle Optimization of Offshore Oil Infrastructure in African Operations
detail.abstract: Offshore oil infrastructure plays a critical role in Africa's energy production and economic development. However, operational inefficiencies, high maintenance costs, environmental risks, and aging infrastructure challenge optimal performance. This study explores lifecycle optimization strategies for offshore oil platforms in African operations, focusing on predictive maintenance, digital tools, cost management, and environmental sustainability. The methodology integrates literature review, optimization model assessment, and analysis of digital monitoring techniques. Findings indicate that lifecycle optimization reduces operational downtime, improves cost efficiency, and mitigates environmental impacts. Furthermore, the adoption of smart asset management and real-time monitoring enhances safety and operational reliability. The study concludes that applying tailored lifecycle optimization strategies is essential for sustainable and economically viable offshore operations in Africa, highlighting the need for region-specific models and further research into digital integration and climate adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨非洲海上石油平台生命周期优化策略，通过预测性维护、数字化工具、成本管理和环境可持续性等方法，旨在减少停机时间、提高成本效益并降低环境影响。
AI.research_question: 如何通过生命周期优化策略提升非洲海上石油平台的操作效率、成本效益和环境可持续性？
AI.motivation: 非洲海上石油基础设施面临运营效率低下、维护成本高、环境风险大和设施老化等挑战，需要优化策略来确保可持续和经济可行的运营。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期优化理论、预测性维护理论、数字化资产管理理论、环境可持续性理论
AI.method: 文献综述、优化模型评估、数字化监测技术分析
AI.findings: 生命周期优化能减少运营停机时间、提高成本效率、减轻环境影响；智能资产管理和实时监测能增强安全性和运营可靠性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为非洲海上石油平台生命周期管理提供了理论框架，强调了区域特定模型的重要性，推动了数字化集成和气候适应研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲海上石油运营商提供了具体的优化策略，包括预测性维护、数字化工具应用、成本管理和环境风险管理，有助于提高运营效率和可持续性。

title: The Inevitability of Marbury v. Madison
affiliations: Israel Supreme Court

detail.title: The Inevitability of Marbury v. Madison

publicationDetails.detailsText: ICL - Vienna Journal on International Constitutional Law (forthcoming in 2026)

detail.abstract:
This Article uncovers three pivotal insights from Marbury v. Madison, highlighting their universal significance and enduring relevance in contemporary constitutional practice. Specifically, it argues that Chief Justice Marshall’s reasoning in this landmark decision built up a distinctly positivist value-free conception of legality capable of resolving constitutional crises. Based on this argument, the Article positions Marbury v. Madison not only as a foundational precedent for judicial review in the United States but also as a precursor to modern constitutional practice worldwide.

The positivist insights extracted from Marshall’s decision include the following: (1) the treatment of law as a social fact; (2) the adoption of an “internal point of view” in interpreting legal texts; and (3) the identification of “secondary” power-conferring rules that derive from the foundational “rule of recognition.” The Article reveals that Marshall’s insights align remarkably with the principles of legal positivism articulated by H.L.A. Hart and his followers over 150 years later. The Article examines these insights in light of recent constitutional developments in Israel, where the author, as a Supreme Court Justice, applied Marshall’s jurisprudential framework to address fundamental questions that arose in connection with judicial review and constitutional amendments. This discussion goes beyond Israel’s borders: it demonstrates that Marshall’s positivist framework is essential for legitimizing judicial review and articulating the notion of “constitutionality.” By uncovering the conceptual necessity of this framework for all forms of judicial review, the Article brings to light the timeless and universal nature of the Marbury v. Madison decision, emphasizing its continued relevance in addressing contemporary constitutional challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文从马伯里诉麦迪逊案中提炼出三个实证主义法学洞见，论证这些洞见具有普遍意义，能够解决宪法危机，并将该案定位为全球现代宪法实践的先驱。
AI.research_question: 马伯里诉麦迪逊案中的实证主义法学洞见是什么？这些洞见如何具有普遍意义并适用于当代宪法实践？
AI.motivation: 重新解读马伯里诉麦迪逊案，揭示其中蕴含的实证主义法学思想，证明这些思想不仅对美国司法审查具有奠基意义，而且对全球现代宪法实践具有普遍指导价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律实证主义理论，特别是H.L.A.哈特及其追随者的法律实证主义原则，包括社会事实理论、内部观点解释方法、承认规则和次级授权规则等概念。
AI.method: 文本分析法：分析马歇尔大法官在马伯里诉麦迪逊案中的推理逻辑；比较研究法：将马歇尔的洞见与哈特的法律实证主义理论进行比较；案例研究法：以以色列最高法院的宪法实践为案例，应用马歇尔的法学框架。
AI.findings: 1. 马歇尔在马伯里诉麦迪逊案中提出了三个实证主义洞见：法律作为社会事实、采用内部观点解释法律文本、识别源自承认规则的次级授权规则；2. 这些洞见与150年后哈特的法律实证主义原则惊人一致；3. 该实证主义框架对司法审查的合法化和"合宪性"概念的阐述至关重要；4. 这一框架具有普遍适用性，能够解决当代宪法挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 重新定位马伯里诉麦迪逊案的理论意义，将其从单纯的美国司法审查先例提升为全球现代宪法实践的理论先驱；2. 建立了马歇尔法学思想与哈特法律实证主义之间的理论联系；3. 提出了实证主义法学框架对司法审查合法化的概念必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为以色列最高法院处理司法审查和宪法修正案问题提供了实用的法学框架；2. 为各国处理宪法危机提供了可操作的理论工具；3. 强调了马伯里诉麦迪逊案对当代宪法实践的持续指导意义；4. 为全球宪法实践提供了普遍适用的实证主义分析框架。

title: Switching Gradient: Learning to Compete with Price-Matching Guarantee
affiliations: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, Northwestern University - Department of Industrial Engineering and Management Sciences,  and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics - School of Information Management and Engineering

detail.title: Switching Gradient: Learning to Compete with Price-Matching Guarantee
detail.abstract: Price-Matching Guarantee (PMG) has become a widespread strategy among retailers to attract and retain customers by promising to match lower prices. However, how sellers should dynamically set prices under PMG, especially without full knowledge of price competition, remains unclear. We model online price competition in a duopoly market with asymmetric PMG adoption. Customers request refunds when the price difference exceeds their hassle threshold, thereby distorting both sellers' revenue functions. Each seller observes only their own realized demand and must learn to optimize on the fly without knowing the demand model or the other seller's information. The setting poses unique challenges, including discontinuous and non-convex revenue functions due to PMG, as well as biased and incomplete feedback arising from online competition. To address these challenges, we propose a novel switching gradient algorithm, in which the PMG provider alternates between real and artificial gradients based on a diagnostic function, while the other seller ignores PMG distortions in gradient estimation. Our algorithm achieves dynamic regret of order $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ for the PMG provider and $\mathcal{O}(\log T \sqrt{T})$ for the other seller, along with last-iterate convergence to the static Nash equilibrium at rate $\mathcal{O}(\log T / \sqrt{T})$. We introduce a new analytical framework to rigorously quantify regret and convergence rates under asymmetric knowledge and heterogeneous step sizes. For retailers adopting PMG or other pricing mechanisms that introduce discontinuities in revenue, our framework offers a practical way to adapt classical gradient-based learning algorithms to accommodate structural complexities. For sellers competing against PMG adopters, our findings indicate that conventional pricing policies may remain effective, even without adjustment to the new environment, and that the burden of adaptation lies primarily on the PMG provider. Furthermore, we demonstrate that improved revenue and convergence may not be achieved without additional information sharing, highlighting the ``Price of Non-Cooperation''.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线双寡头市场中，价格匹配保证（PMG）下的动态定价策略。卖家在信息不对称（仅观察自身需求）且PMG导致收益函数不连续的情况下，通过提出的切换梯度算法实现动态定价优化。
AI.research_question: 在信息不对称的在线双寡头市场中，卖家如何在价格匹配保证（PMG）导致收益函数不连续且仅能观察自身需求的情况下，动态优化定价策略？
AI.motivation: 价格匹配保证已成为零售商吸引和保留客户的广泛策略，但卖家在缺乏完全价格竞争知识的情况下如何动态定价尚不明确。PMG导致收益函数不连续和非凸，同时在线竞争产生有偏和不完整的反馈，这些挑战需要新的算法框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非对称PMG采用的双寡头市场模型、动态定价理论、在线学习算法、纳什均衡理论、遗憾分析框架。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的切换梯度算法：PMG提供者基于诊断函数在真实梯度和人工梯度之间切换，而其他卖家忽略PMG扭曲进行梯度估计。使用新的分析框架量化非对称知识和异质步长下的遗憾和收敛率。
AI.findings: 算法为PMG提供者实现O(√T)的动态遗憾，为其他卖家实现O(log T √T)的动态遗憾，并以O(log T/√T)的速率收敛到静态纳什均衡。传统定价策略对非PMG卖家仍然有效，适应负担主要在PMG提供者身上。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出处理PMG导致收益函数不连续性的切换梯度算法；2）建立非对称知识和异质步长下的遗憾和收敛率分析框架；3）量化"非合作价格"，证明无额外信息共享无法改善收益和收敛。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为采用PMG或其他引入收益不连续性的零售商提供适应经典梯度学习算法的实用框架；2）为与非PMG卖家竞争的企业提供策略指导；3）揭示适应负担主要在PMG提供者身上，传统定价策略仍可有效。

title: Period Talk on the Factory Floor: Evidence from a Workplace Menstrual Awareness Campaign Involving Men
affiliations: Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU)

detail.title: Period Talk on the Factory Floor: Evidence from a Workplace Menstrual Awareness Campaign Involving Men
detail.abstract: Menstruation is a common biological process that affects women at work, yet in many LMICs it is expected to be managed in private and is rarely considered when organizations address workers' needs. This paper studies a large-scale menstrual awareness campaign in a Bangladeshi garment factory, where short audio messages about menstruation were broadcast daily over factory loudspeakers and heard by both women and men. Using before-after survey data from a panel of workers, we show that men are already heavily involved in menstrual management prior to the campaign, with many reporting that they buy pads for their wives because they feel ashamed purchasing commercial absorbents themselves. Following the campaign, menstrual stigma and taboos decline for both women and men, and restrictive social norms become more permissive for behaviors related to cross-gender communication and purchasing menstrual products, while norms limiting the washing and drying of reusable absorbents remain more resistant to change. These findings suggest that low-cost, mixed-gender workplace campaigns can shift the social environment surrounding menstruation at scale, pointing to a feasible organizational strategy to reduce hidden, norm-driven barriers to women’s well-being and labor participation in low- and middle-income countries.

AI.tldr: 在孟加拉国服装厂进行的大规模月经意识宣传活动显示，低成本、混合性别的职场干预能有效减少月经污名，改善社会规范，促进女性福祉和劳动参与。
AI.research_question: 低成本、混合性别的月经意识宣传活动能否在低收入和中等收入国家的工作场所中减少月经污名、改变限制性社会规范，从而改善女性福祉和劳动参与？
AI.motivation: 月经是影响职场女性的常见生理现象，但在许多低收入和中等收入国家，月经被视为私密话题，组织很少考虑员工的相关需求。这种污名和禁忌可能成为女性福祉和劳动参与的隐藏障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会规范理论、污名化理论、性别平等理论、组织行为理论
AI.method: 在孟加拉国一家服装厂进行准实验研究，通过工厂广播系统播放关于月经的简短音频信息（男女员工都能听到），使用前后调查面板数据评估干预效果。
AI.findings: 1) 干预前男性已深度参与月经管理（如为妻子购买卫生巾）；2) 干预后男女的月经污名和禁忌均减少；3) 跨性别沟通和购买月经产品的社会规范变得更为宽松；4) 限制清洗和晾晒可重复使用吸收用品的规范更难改变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展了工作场所社会规范干预的理论框架；2) 揭示了男性在月经管理中的实际角色；3) 区分了不同类型社会规范对干预的响应差异；4) 为减少性别相关污名提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一种低成本、可扩展的组织策略来改善女性员工福祉；2) 展示了混合性别干预的有效性；3) 为低收入和中等收入国家企业减少性别障碍提供了具体方案；4) 指出了需要针对性解决的社会规范类型。

title: Geometric Cointegration and Rotor Dynamics in the Term Structure of Interest Rates
affiliations: GeometriX Intelligence and

detail.title: Geometric Cointegration and Rotor Dynamics in the Term Structure of Interest Rates
detail.abstract: We introduce geometric cointegration, a framework that replaces the classical fixed-vector projection of cointegration analysis with a time-varying unit normal vector governed by rotor dynamics on the unit sphere. Classical cointegration imposes a constant equilibrium hyperplane on a system of I(1) series, an assumption that may be empirically restrictive across the severaldecade horizons relevant to interest rate modelling. Our approach embeds the cointegrating vector on S d-1 and tracks its evolution through a sequence of minimal rotations, each parameterised by a scalar rotation angle α t calibrated via a penalised least-squares objective that balances fit against rotational inertia controlled by a smoothness hyperparameter λ > 0. Applied to 413 monthly observations of US Treasury yields (3-month, 2-year, and 10-year maturities) spanning January 1990 to May 2024, the framework reveals a yield-curve equilibrium that is geometrically stable yet structurally time-varying. In the 2-dimensional system pairing TB3MS and DGS10 (with λ = 5.0), the mean absolute rotation angle is 0.02042 radians (1.17 •), confirming that the equilibrium normal remains in a well-defined small-angle regime throughout the sample. The maximum absolute angle of 0.13022 radians (7.46 •) occurs during peak macrofinancial stress episodes. The equilibrium error u t = n ⊤ t z t exhibits a standard deviation of 0.1674 in standardised units, while the cointegrating direction ϕ t traces a total arc of 79.65 • across the 34-year sample. The 3-dimensional blade system incorporating the 2-year yield produces even smaller rotations (mean 1.10 • , maximum 5.61 •), consistent with the additional constraint imposed by a third maturity. We establish formally that in the small-angle limit the rotor correction reduces exactly to a classical error-correction mechanism (ECM), with the equilibrium error shrinking at rate λ/(B 2 t + λ) per period. As λ → ∞ the cointegrating vector freezes and the model collapses to standard Johansen cointegration. The hyperparameter λ therefore provides a continuous bridge between the two extremes. We further show that the squared rotation angle α * 2 t constitutes a natural geometric energy that spikes sharply at the Global Financial Crisis (2008-2009), the COVID-19 shock (2020), and the early-1990s monetary tightening episode-making it a potential real-time macro-stress indicator. Nelson-Siegel factor projections of the 3D blade reveal that the 1 slope direction dominates, consistent with the empirical primacy of the level-slope structure in term structure models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了几何协整框架，用由转子动力学控制的时变单位法向量取代经典协整分析中的固定向量投影。该方法将协整向量嵌入S^{d-1}球面，通过最小旋转序列跟踪其演化，旋转角度由惩罚最小二乘目标校准。应用于1990-2024年美国国债收益率数据，揭示了收益率曲线均衡在几何稳定但结构时变的特性。
AI.research_question: 如何在协整分析中处理时变的均衡关系，特别是当经典协整的固定均衡超平面假设在数十年时间跨度内可能过于限制时？
AI.motivation: 经典协整分析假设系统存在固定的均衡超平面，这在利率建模等长期分析中可能过于严格。现实中的经济关系可能随时间演变，需要能够捕捉这种时变均衡关系的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 几何协整理论，将协整向量视为单位球面上的时变法向量，通过转子动力学描述其演化。建立在小角度极限下退化为经典误差修正机制的理论联系。
AI.method: 将协整向量嵌入S^{d-1}单位球面，通过最小旋转序列跟踪演化，旋转角度α_t由惩罚最小二乘目标校准（平衡拟合度与旋转惯性）。应用于413个月度美国国债收益率数据（3个月、2年、10年期）。
AI.findings: 1) 收益率曲线均衡在几何上稳定但结构时变；2) 2维系统中平均旋转角1.17°，最大7.46°（出现在宏观金融压力高峰期）；3) 3维系统旋转更小（平均1.10°，最大5.61°）；4) 旋转角平方构成几何能量指标，在金融危机、COVID-19等时期显著上升；5) Nelson-Siegel因子显示斜率方向占主导。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出几何协整理论框架，统一时变与固定协整关系；2) 证明小角度极限下退化为经典误差修正机制；3) 超参数λ提供从时变到固定协整的连续桥梁；4) 建立旋转角平方作为宏观压力指标的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为利率建模提供更灵活的时变均衡框架；2) 旋转角平方可作为实时宏观压力监测指标；3) 证实收益率曲线均衡关系的时变性但几何稳定性；4) 为长期金融时间序列分析提供新工具。

title: Stimulating Auto Markets
affiliations: Duke University, Fuqua School of Business-Economics Group, Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Department of the Treasury, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and University of Chicago - Finance

detail.title: Stimulating Auto Markets
detail.abstract:
How does fiscal stimulus affect durable goods sales and to what extent does stimulus drive inflation? We study this question in the context of how the unprecedented pandemic fiscal stimulus affected household car purchases and auto prices. Using administrative data on vehicle registrations, we exploit the timing of nearly $900 billion in stimulus payments and geographic differences in program exposure to identify causal effects on sales. We find the stimulus increased purchases by 5.5 million vehicles (3.2%) during 2020–2022, implying a medium-run (3-year) marginal propensity to spend (MPX) on autos of 0.19 and a total marginal propensity to consume (MPC) of 0.47. Despite this substantial demand response, fiscal transfers account for less than 20% of the surge in auto prices. In a general equilibrium model with new and used markets, we show how secondary-market interactions dampen inflation. When transfers push households onto the new-car margin, trade-ins expand used supply and limit price increases. This channel weakens when supply is tight or when policy targets borrowing constraints, in which case stimulus manifests more as inflation than output. Non-fiscal factors, including supply constraints, relaxed credit conditions, and preference shifts, explain the majority of the observed inflation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了疫情财政刺激对汽车销售和价格的影响，发现刺激政策增加了550万辆汽车购买，但对价格上涨的贡献不到20%。研究揭示了二手车市场的缓冲作用如何抑制通胀。
AI.research_question: 财政刺激如何影响耐用消费品销售？刺激政策在多大程度上推动了通胀？特别关注疫情财政刺激对家庭汽车购买和汽车价格的影响。
AI.motivation: 疫情期间前所未有的财政刺激政策为研究财政政策对耐用消费品市场和通胀的影响提供了独特机会，有助于理解刺激政策在不同市场条件下的传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于一般均衡模型，考虑新车和二手车市场的相互作用，分析财政刺激通过影响家庭购买决策、二手车供给和价格传导的机制。
AI.method: 使用车辆注册的行政数据，利用近9000亿美元刺激支付的时机和地区差异来识别对销售的因果效应，并结合一般均衡模型分析。
AI.findings: 1) 刺激政策在2020-2022年间增加了550万辆汽车购买（增长3.2%）；2) 中期（3年）汽车边际消费倾向为0.19，总边际消费倾向为0.47；3) 财政转移支付对汽车价格上涨的贡献不到20%；4) 二手车市场通过增加供给抑制了价格上涨。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了二手车市场在财政刺激传导中的缓冲作用；2) 阐明了供给约束和信贷条件如何改变刺激政策的通胀效应；3) 提供了财政政策在不同市场结构下影响耐用消费品市场的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者评估财政刺激效果提供实证依据；2) 帮助理解刺激政策在供给约束下的不同影响；3) 为设计更有效的经济稳定政策提供参考。

title: Physician Competition: Entry and Substitution
affiliations: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), University of Chicago and Cornell University

detail.title: Physician Competition: Entry and Substitution
detail.abstract:
We describe competition in the physician market, focusing on how entry barriers and substitution possibilities have changed in recent decades. Regulatory caps on medical school seats and residency slots—especially for high-paying specialties—continue to ration entry, generate high returns for those who gain these slots, and direct the most academically accomplished trainees toward lucrative fields. But trained physicians increasingly compete with nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and other mid-level practitioners in the market for patients. Training of these substitutes has expanded far more rapidly than physician supply. We present key facts about the physician pipeline, a conceptual framework linking specialty earnings to entry barriers, and describe the rise of mid-level providers. These facts mean that effective competition policy in physician markets must look beyond conventional concentration measures and focus on the institutions and laws that govern who can provide medical care.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了医生市场的竞争格局，重点关注准入壁垒和替代可能性在近几十年的变化。研究发现，医学院和住院医师名额的管制限制了医生供给，创造了高回报，但护士执业者、医师助理等中级执业者的快速扩张正在改变市场竞争结构。
AI.research_question: 医生市场的竞争结构如何受到准入壁垒和替代提供者扩张的影响？有效的医疗市场竞争政策应该如何设计？
AI.motivation: 传统上医生市场分析主要关注市场集中度，但忽视了准入管制和替代提供者扩张对竞争的实际影响。需要重新思考医疗市场竞争政策的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合产业组织理论（准入壁垒、市场结构）和人力资本理论（专业选择、回报率），构建连接专业收入与准入壁垒的概念框架。
AI.method: 描述性分析，呈现医生培养管道的关键事实，分析准入管制的制度安排，追踪中级执业者的扩张趋势。
AI.findings: 1. 医学院和住院医师名额管制持续限制医生供给，特别是高薪专科；2. 这些管制为获得名额者创造了高回报；3. 最优秀的学员被导向高薪领域；4. 中级执业者培训扩张速度远超医生供给增长；5. 医生面临来自替代提供者的竞争加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了医疗市场竞争分析的理论框架，强调准入管制和替代提供者作为竞争约束的重要性，超越了传统的市场集中度分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供新的竞争政策方向：应关注管理医疗服务的制度和法律，而非仅依赖传统集中度指标，以促进医疗市场的有效竞争。

title: International Comparison of Physician Incomes
affiliations: University of Chicago, National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), University of Chicago, University of British Columbia (UBC), IFAU - Institute for Labour Market Policy Evaluation, IZA Institute of Labor Economics, Stockholm University - Department of Economics, Stanford University, University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Economics, Government of the United States of America - Bureau of the Census and

detail.title: International Comparison of Physician Incomes
detail.abstract:
We compare physician incomes using tax data from the United States, Canada, Sweden, and the Netherlands. Physicians are concentrated in the top percentiles of the income distribution in all four countries, especially in the United States and certain specialties. Physician incomes are highest in the United States, and a decomposition shows that this mainly reflects differences in overall income distributions, rather than physicians’ locations in those distributions. This suggests that broader labor market differences, and thus physicians’ outside options, drive absolute incomes. Shifting US physicians’ incomes to match relative positions in other countries’ distributions would only marginally reduce healthcare spending.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用美国、加拿大、瑞典和荷兰的税收数据比较医生收入。医生在所有四国都集中在收入分布的顶端，尤其是在美国和某些专科。美国医生收入最高，分解分析显示这主要反映了整体收入分布的差异，而非医生在分布中的相对位置。这表明更广泛的劳动力市场差异（即医生的外部选择机会）驱动绝对收入水平。将美国医生的收入调整到与其他国家相对位置匹配，对医疗支出的影响有限。
AI.research_question: 不同国家（美国、加拿大、瑞典、荷兰）医生收入的差异有多大？这些差异主要是由医生在各自国家收入分布中的相对位置差异驱动，还是由各国整体收入分布差异驱动？
AI.motivation: 医生收入是医疗成本的重要组成部分，但跨国比较研究有限。了解医生收入差异的来源对于评估医疗支出政策、理解医疗劳动力市场以及探讨收入不平等问题具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场理论和收入分布理论，特别是医生作为高技能专业人员的市场地位、各国劳动力市场制度差异对收入分布的影响，以及医生外部选择机会（outside options）对收入水平的决定作用。
AI.method: 使用美国、加拿大、瑞典和荷兰的税收数据，进行跨国比较分析。采用分解方法（decomposition analysis）区分医生收入差异的两个来源：1）医生在各自国家收入分布中的相对位置；2）各国整体收入分布的差异。
AI.findings: 1. 医生在所有四国都集中在收入分布的顶端，尤其是在美国和某些专科；2. 美国医生收入绝对水平最高；3. 分解分析显示，美国医生收入高的主要原因是美国整体收入分布更不平等（整体收入水平更高），而非医生在美国收入分布中的相对位置特别高；4. 将美国医生的收入调整到与其他国家相对位置匹配，对医疗支出的影响很小。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了医生收入跨国比较的系统证据；2. 区分了医生收入差异的两个来源：相对位置效应和整体分布效应；3. 支持了"外部选择机会"理论在解释医生收入差异中的作用；4. 挑战了简单将医生高收入归因于其在医疗系统中特殊地位的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定者应认识到，降低美国医生收入对控制医疗支出的效果有限；2. 医生收入差异主要反映各国整体劳动力市场差异，而非医疗系统特殊性；3. 为医疗劳动力市场政策提供了实证依据；4. 对医疗改革中关于医生薪酬的讨论提供了重要参考。

title: Predation by Geographic Relocation or Product Mimicry
affiliations: Chapman University

detail.title: Predation by Geographic Relocation or Product Mimicry

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: This paper provides conditions when a firm can impose asymmetric costs upon another equally efficient firm by moving close to the target firm in geographic space or by mimicking product characteristics, simply by reason of its larger size. The paper provides a theoretical existence theorem for effective predation. It also identifies that in cases of more than one geographic dimension or more than one salient characteristic, the ratio of firm sizes between the larger and the smaller must be within a specific range dictated by geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了大型企业如何通过地理空间接近或模仿产品特征，对同等效率的竞争对手施加不对称成本优势，并建立了有效掠夺的理论存在定理。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下，大型企业可以通过地理空间接近或产品特征模仿，对同等效率的较小企业施加不对称成本优势，从而实现有效掠夺？
AI.motivation: 研究大型企业利用其规模优势，通过战略性的地理定位或产品特征模仿，对较小但同等效率的竞争对手施加成本压力，从而影响市场竞争格局。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于掠夺性定价理论、空间竞争模型（Hotelling模型）和不对称成本理论，探讨规模差异如何影响企业的战略定位决策。
AI.method: 采用理论建模方法，建立存在定理证明有效掠夺的可能性，并分析在多维地理空间或多个显著特征情况下，企业规模比例与几何约束的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 大型企业可以通过接近目标企业的地理位置或模仿其产品特征，对同等效率的较小企业施加不对称成本；2. 存在有效掠夺的理论可能性；3. 在多维情况下，企业规模比例必须满足由几何条件决定的特定范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了有效掠夺的存在定理；2. 将空间竞争模型扩展到规模不对称情况；3. 揭示了多维竞争环境下规模比例与几何约束的关系。

title: Blockchain, Financial Reporting Quality, and Investment Efficiency
affiliations: NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Accounting, Auditing and Law, University of Hawaii, Manoa, NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Accounting, Auditing and Law and National Central University

detail.title: Blockchain, Financial Reporting Quality, and Investment Efficiency

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Accounting and Public Policy 57 (2026) 107422

detail.abstract: This study examines the relation between blockchain adoption and investment efficiency. Using a difference-in-differences approach with a matched sample of firms that disclosed blockchain adoption in 8-K filings between 2014 and 2023, we find that adopters exhibit higher investment efficiency after adoption compared to non-adopters. We also find that blockchain adoption is positively associated with financial reporting quality, suggesting that enhanced financial reporting quality might be a mechanism through which blockchain adoption improves investment efficiency. Further analyses show that the effect of blockchain adoption on investment efficiency varies with firms’ information environments and across types of blockchain applications. The effect is most pronounced among firms with weak information environments and those adopting non-cryptocurrency applications, where blockchain’s potential to improve investment efficiency is expected to be greater. Overall, our findings provide insights into how blockchain technology can influence financial reporting practices and corporate investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 区块链采用能提升企业投资效率，主要通过改善财务报告质量实现，效果在信息环境弱的企业和非加密货币应用中更显著。
